Global Beverage Firms Eye Indian IPOs for Market Expansion

Global beverage companies Carlsberg, Pernod Ricard, and Coca-Cola are reportedly advancing plans to launch Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) in India. These moves indicate a strategic interest from major international beverage giants in tapping into the Indian capital markets for expansion and growth.
